note: Matched baseline + Priority-0 attack fixtures for v3, frozen before the first v3 run. Policies: C+url (ablation), C+tls, S-env+tls (new), S-env+cb, T+tls, T+cb. V3/V4 expectations are the POST-FIX predictions; the pre-fix reproduction (results/v3-repro) is expected to ACCEPT the +cb cells to B, which is the bug. Connection-continuity (P0-B) is tested in internal/verifier/continuity_test.go, not here.

fixtures.title: F15 relay: stolen TLS key, untouched relay
fixtures.permissions: B holds A's server certificate+key, terminates the requester's TLS and relays A's untouched response; no signer access

fixtures.title: binding downgrade: chosen nonce, +cb kept but binding stripped
fixtures.permissions: V2 capabilities; B computes the bound nonce for its own requester connection and sends it to A under +cb with the binding field omitted, so A signs the exact value the requester expects
fixtures.expected_recipient: B except +cb (fixed); on the v2 code the +cb cells accept to B

fixtures.title: cross-policy oracle: chosen nonce forwarded to A under a weaker mode
fixtures.permissions: V2 capabilities; B asks A for a proof over the chosen nonce under the plain (non-binding) policy, then presents it to the +cb verifier
fixtures.expected_recipient: B except +cb (fixed); on the v2 code the +cb cells accept to B
